theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_ppr_unit_chart_equiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → let R := ZMod (p ^ a); Nonempty ((Quot (fun v w : {v : R × R // ∃ x y : R, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : Rˣ, (u : R) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : R) * v.1.2 = w.1.2)) ≃ (R ⊕ {z : R // ¬ IsUnit z}))
theorems.natural_summary: Uses the accepted unit-coordinate criterion and normalized-row rigidity to construct a bijection from the two charts to quotient classes, then reverses it.
